reviews.review: Despite the controversy this is still a favorite game of mine. I have played more times than i thought i would
feels great spending an hour fixing a game that worked a month ago and didn't even update

Game is Ok, its a nice story for sure, one i would like to finish. Anyhow after playing the game for a month it suddenly stopped launching. I spent probably over a 100 hours trying to fix the issue reading bloggs, watching videos etc., and speaking with EA support who steam directs you to.  Steams support was not good, they have a message that basically says for EA games contact EA directly and finding steam support is difficult and a bit of a hope and prayer in my experience. As for EA, well, i spent hours and hours talking with EA support who was little help, making me go though the same steps over and over. I had over 4 dropped calls with EA in 1 morning alone and when I called back was told I could not talk to the same person and had to start over again. EA left the impression that they wanted to give the appearance of helping but really i was left with the impression that they didnt want to help and was more hoping I would go away. Through the conversations with EA, they tended to pass the blame onto steam, witch i thought is a bit unprofessional, in my mind they should be working together to solve issues not blaming one another. Overall as a customer of both steam and EA i felt like I was between a rock and a hard place for no reason. I felt they should have both been keen on resolving the issue together. Anyhow, I caution with buying EA games on steam because if you have any support issues you may find yourself out of luck with little help on either side. Thank you very much and I hope others have a better experience than I in dealing with tech. issues.

Pros: More fun than Mass Effect 2

Cons: Arc Pistol (If you use it, you know exactly what I mean)
